questions.question: What does successful retrieval on the training pairs establish?
options: The encoder solves those pairs under that pairing and augmentation contract.
Lowering the temperature parameter \(\tau\) improves the nearest-neighbor ranking order of the cosine matrix.
Diagonal-only supervision automatically merges duplicate semantic examples into a single positive target.
questions.explanation: Training-pair retrieval shows that this objective and implementation can fit the observed pairs. It does not establish held-out semantic retrieval, robustness, or the absence of duplicate-positive problems. Keep the evaluation candidate pool and split identities separate.
optionFeedback: Training-pair retrieval shows that this objective and implementation can fit the observed pairs. It does not establish held-out semantic retrieval, robustness, or the absence of duplicate-positive problems. Keep the evaluation candidate pool and split identities separate.
Temperature rescales logits but does not change a fixed embedding’s cosine ranking. Training effects require a separate comparison.
A diagonal label still penalizes duplicate positives in other columns. Use a multi-positive objective or data policy when the task requires it.
